title: WordLookupResult
description:
Top-level result of looking up a word form in the dictionary.

The engine **never picks one variant** — it returns all the data it holds so that callers can apply their own resolution strategy (NLP context in Python, tooltip in the browser, etc.).

readings.description: All stress variants with full phonetics and morphology. Empty if the word is not in the dictionary.

ConsonantFeatures.description: Full 5-dimensional feature vector for a consonant phoneme. Directly parallels the TypeScript `ConsonantFeatures` interface.

nasal.description: True only for nasal consonants (м, н, нь).  Redundant with `manner == Nasal` but kept for TypeScript API parity.

MorphReading.description:
One morphological analysis (POS + features + lemma) for a word form.

A single stress variant may represent multiple syncretised forms; e.g. «ру́ки» is both nominative plural AND genitive singular of «рука». In that case there will be two `MorphReading`s with the same `StressReading`.

All names follow the [Universal Dependencies](https://universaldependencies.org/) annotation convention.

definition.description: Short sense label from Wiktionary (e.g. `"castle"` vs `"lock"` for «замок»). Used as a disambiguation hint when `pos` and `feats` are identical. `None` if not available in the source data.

feats.description: UD morphological features: key → allowed values. Multiple values per key encode syncretism (e.g. `Case → ["Acc", "Nom"]`).

lemma.description: Base form (lemma), or `None` if not stored.

pos.description: Universal POS tags, e.g. `["NOUN"]`.  Typically one element.

PhoneticToken.description:
A single phoneme token produced by the tokenizer and transformed by subsequent passes.

Passes operate on `&mut Vec<PhoneticToken>` (or return a new `Vec` when tokens must be removed).

consonantFeatures.description: Feature vector for consonants.  `None` for vowels.

ipa.description: Current IPA symbol for this phoneme.  May be mutated by passes (e.g., voicing assimilation changes "s" → "z").

palatalized.description: Whether this consonant has been palatalized (softened). When true, `ipa` ends with ʲ (e.g. "nʲ").

source.description: The Cyrillic source grapheme(s) that produced this token.

stressed.description: Whether this is the stressed vowel.  Set by `vowel_allophones` pass.

vowelFeatures.description: Feature vector for vowels.  `None` for consonants.

vowelIndex.description: 0-based index of this vowel among all vowels in the word. `-1` for non-vowel tokens.

StressReading.description:
Complete analysis for **one stress variant** of a word form.

Carries three parallel representations of the same phonological unit:

| Level | Field | Example (`замок`, stress 0) | |---|---|---| | Written | `form` | `замок` | | Stressed | `stressed_form` | `за́мок` | | Syllabified written | `word_syllables` | `["за", "мок"]` | | IPA | `ipa` | `zɑmɔk` | | Syllabified IPA | `ipa_syllables` | `["ˈzɑ", "mɔk"]` |

`word_syllables[i]` and `ipa_syllables[i]` correspond to the same syllable. Joining `word_syllables` reconstructs `form`. Stripping leading `ˈ` from each `ipa_syllables[i]` and joining gives `ipa`.

confidence.description: How stress was determined.  Always `None` for Ukrainian (all entries are confirmed dictionary forms).  `"exact"|"rule"|"default"` for Polish.

form.description: Normalized form: lowercased, canonical straight apostrophe `'`.

ipa.description: Flat IPA string for the whole word.

ipaSyllables.description: IPA per syllable.  The stressed syllable is prefixed with `ˈ` (U+02C8) following standard IPA notation.  No `ˈ` for purely consonantal words.

morph.description: All morphological analyses that share this stress position. Multiple entries represent syncretism or same-stress homography.

stressFromEnd.description: 1-based position from the end (2 = penultimate, 3 = antepenultimate). `0` for zero-vowel words.

stressedForm.description: `form` with a combining acute accent (U+0301) placed after the stressed vowel: `за́мок`.  Equals `form` when there is no vowel.

syllableCount.description: Number of syllables.  `1` for purely consonantal words (the whole word counts as one phonological unit).

syllableIndex.description: 0-based index of the stressed syllable (= stressed vowel index for normal words where each syllable has one vowel nucleus). `0` for zero-vowel (purely consonantal) words.

tokens.description: Token-level phonetic detail produced by the 6-pass pipeline. Useful for NLP/ML consumers; can be ignored for most use cases.

wordSyllables.description: Original graphemes grouped by syllable, aligned positionally with `ipa_syllables`.  Joining gives `form`.

TokenType.description: The kind of sound a `PhoneticToken` represents.

oneOf.description: A glide (j, w, u̯) — neither fully consonant nor vowel.
A glottal stop/boundary — produced by the apostrophe grapheme.

VoicePower.description: Voicing class of a consonant.  Sonorants (m, n, l, r, j, ʋ) are exempt from obstruent voicing assimilation.

oneOf.description: Nasals, liquids, glides — no voicing assimilation applies.

VowelFeatures.description: Full 3-dimensional feature vector for a vowel phoneme.

stable.description: Stable vowels (/і/, /у/, /а/) do not shift in unstressed position.

VowelHeight.description: Height position of a vowel in the oral cavity.
